    dim = [31, 29 if leap else 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    days_in_month = dim[month - 1]
    offset = (weekday - first_dow) % 7
    total = 0
    day = 1 + offset
    while day <= days_in_month:
        total += 1
        day += 7
    return total

def chunk_fixed_size(lst, k):
    chunks = []
    i = 0
    n = len(lst)
    while i < n:
        chunks.append(lst[i:i + k])
        i += k
    return chunks
